metadata.title: Get-All-EV-Logs
metadata.description:
This script collects any event log name and exports them into an HTML report in location C:\EV_LOGS\EV_Events.html
Should work on all Windows 10 versions. 

---| Syntax: 

.\Get-All-EV-Logs.ps1 -Logname <string> -Provider <string> -Keyword <string> -MaxEvents <int> -Type <string>

---| Caveats: 

1. Logname is mandatory / You can use keyword wildcards / Minimum 2 characters
2. You can use * for Providers / You can leave MaxEvents (default is 50 results) / You can leave Keyword blank
3. For Levels you have 5 to choose: Critical, Error, Warning, Informational or All (default is All)

---| Examples:

.\Get-All-EV-Logs.ps1 -Logname AAD

.\Get-All-EV-Logs.ps1 -Logname Applocker -Provider * -MaxEvents 10

.\Get-All-EV-Logs.ps1 -Logname AAD -Provider * -Keyword cloud -Type Informational

.\Get-All-EV-Logs.ps1 -Logname Applocker -Provider * -MaxEvents 10
